operation.description:
Forces the removal of a self-hosted runner from a repository. You can use this endpoint to completely remove the runner when the machine you were using no longer exists.

Authenticated users must have admin access to the repository to use this endpoint.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.
operation.summary: Delete a self-hosted runner from a repository

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/parameters/runner-id.description: Unique identifier of the self-hosted runner.
#/components/parameters/runner-id.name: runner_id

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.
